The name is Bond… James Bond.

Robert Pattinson is officially the new 007, stepping into one of cinema’s most iconic roles for the next chapter of the James Bond franchise.

The first teaser reveals Pattinson suited up as the legendary MI6 agent, marking the beginning of a completely new era following Daniel Craig’s final appearance as Bond in No Time to Die.

The upcoming 26th James Bond movie will be directed by acclaimed filmmaker Denis Villeneuve, known for Dune, Blade Runner 2049 and Arrival. Steven Knight, creator of Peaky Blinders, is writing the screenplay, with Amy Pascal and David Heyman producing for Amazon MGM Studios.

🔫 JAMES BOND / 007
⭐ Robert Pattinson as James Bond
🎬 Directed by Denis Villeneuve
✍️ Written by Steven Knight
🎥 Produced by Amy Pascal & David Heyman
🏢 Amazon MGM Studios
🕶️ Action / Spy / Thriller
🎞️ Official 007 Teaser

After more than six decades of missions, villains, Aston Martins and shaken martinis, a new James Bond has arrived.
